proseStories.heading: ED Corner – July 2026
proseStories.originalText: Happy July, everyone! It's been an amazing summer so far of cookouts, nights spent with friends, and of course, refreshing Happy Hours to help us cool down. ... Have a great month! Yours in Service, Jodie Bilskie, Executive Director

proseStories.heading: Legacy News
proseStories.originalText: Birthdays are a time for having family around to help celebrate making everything better. Sharon's family celebrated with her by bringing the whole lane cupcakes for her birthday.

proseStories.heading: Volunteer (from Optional Suggestions)
proseStories.originalText: Do you want to kick this month off with a bang? We have an idea for that to happen… come and join our volunteer team. Please see Wendie in Life Enrichment for volunteering opportunities.

proseStories.heading: Summer Field Trips — Indianapolis Zoo (from Optional Suggestions)
proseStories.originalText: We enjoyed a wonderful day at the Indianapolis Zoo, exploring exhibits, seeing amazing animals, and making special memories with friends. The outing was filled with smiles and plenty of summer fun. We look forward to more adventures together.

proseStories.heading: Divisional Outing — Evansville Otters (from Optional Suggestions)
proseStories.originalText: We knocked it out of the park during our divisional outing to the Evansville Otters Baseball game! We enjoyed cheering from the stands, snacking on the ballpark treats, and debating whether the players or the fans were having more fun. It was a home run of a day filled with laughter and plenty of team spirit.
